svg.text: Three stacked flats, each carries one slice of the name. The slices line up from your seat only; lean, and the name tears.
print file: ink only on the slices (shown exactly as projected)
base: 6 slits hold the tabs (0.4 mm card, press-fit)
slits at 0 / 47 / 76 mm - the spacing IS the spell
eye (430 high, 450 away) - rays drawn schematically
Each card ends exactly where the sight line over the card in front reaches it, so
the visible bands tile with no gap. Ink is projected from the eye onto each card:
letter slices on card k = (text ∩ band k) projected eye → card plane.
render of the real print file, seen from four places
